analyst: Manual analysis using Claude Opus 5.5 for verification and code analysis

servers.server_cost: Requires a "Similarweb subscription with API/MCP access" (API-only, Business or Enterprise); every call consumes data credits ("MCP uses data credits the same way standard API responses do"; no figures per call)
servers.linked_cost: Web Intelligence from $125/month (small companies); Business/Enterprise and API on request; MCP is a feature of AI Studio / Data as a Service without a separate price
servers.pricing: Data credits per call, consumption depends on the prompt and the amount of data ("Queries that pull more data points use more credits")
servers.restrictions: Subscription with API/MCP access; Audience Overlap 2-5 websites; ASO Keyword Rank History up to 50 keywords; other limits not given
servers.governance_logic: Every call is charged in data credits; consumption depends on the agent's queries. Read only (single scope read). Per-tool input limits. No spending limits or cost warnings described on the server side.
servers.actions_comment: 43 according to the setup page (19 web/traffic + 4 search + 20 apps/ASO)
servers.token_method: Descriptions not published; with 40+ tools the context is noticeable
servers.agent_cannot: Amazon data and lead enrichment (announced on the landing page, no tools in the list); manage the account, credits, reports and dashboards; check the credit balance (separate API page).
servers.docs_recs: Disclaimers: AI answers "may be incomplete, inaccurate, or subject to AI interpretation"; use "at the user's sole risk"; no warranties for data and conclusions.
servers.gov_promises: No privacy section; only "Secure and scalable".
servers.user_promises: Amazon data and lead enrichment announced on the landing page
servers.promises_vs_logic: Amazon data and lead enrichment promised on the landing page are not in the tool list.
servers.notes: Endpoint https://mcp.similarweb.com (CSV: /mcp). Clients: Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Copilot, Manus, Perplexity, Zapier, n8n and others; custom connections via support. Tool names human-readable.

Tools.desc: 43 tools: web and traffic (19), search (4), apps and ASO (20); all read-only

Authorization.desc: Sign-in to the Similarweb account; protected resource metadata published; scope read (read only)

observations.text: Every action of the agent costs money (credits), and consumption depends on the agent's behaviour; no limits or warnings on the server.
Shift of responsibility for the quality of AI conclusions to the user ("sole risk").
A broad read-only server: 40+ tools, one scope read.
Divergence between marketing and the tool set (Amazon, lead enrichment).
